name: Tuesday
source:
tuesday is a short kinetic visual novel about a young man and his first day at work and the concept of carpe diem. Saying any more than that would be spoiling the story.

Don't rush it, don't worry: just experience it. 

[From [url=https://kyuu.itch.io/tuesday]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《tuesday》是一部短篇动视小说，讲述一名年轻人的第一天工作，以及及时行乐这一概念。再多说就会剧透。

不要着急，也不用担心：亲自体验吧。

[来自[url=https://kyuu.itch.io/tuesday]Itch.io[/url]]
